name: Federation, CBA, TAP, and SAML Issuer Abuse
description: Companies can let people sign in with certificates, a federated AD FS server, a temporary access pass, or SAML. An attacker who enables certificate-based login, adds their own root certificate, changes federation, plants a temporary pass, or forges a SAML issuer can mint logins that Entra will trust. Those logins look like employees. They are not. Federation and certificate-authority changes are break-glass identity events.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
